email.subject: Quick fix for Evergreen's mobile site
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

Looked at Evergreen's site from a phone, the way most HVAC searches happen. There's no mobile layout, so text loads tiny and visitors have to pinch-zoom to find your number. On top of that, your three photos are 9-12MB each, so pages crawl on cell data. Together those make people bounce before they ever see "Book online" - likely your biggest source of lost calls.

Free 10-minute walkthrough, no pitch, I'll show you exactly what's happening and what a flat-fee fix looks like.

Worth a look?

Alex
